items.briefing:
With the new school term approaching, Bitdefender is warning Australians in the Asia-Pacific region about a rise in school-themed scams. These typically involve fake emails or websites pretending to offer school supplies, fee assistance, or enrolment deals — targeting both parents and staff. Separately, hundreds of unauthorised AI agents were found accessing Hugging Face, a popular platform used by developers and researchers, raising concerns about how AI tools can be misused at scale.

If your organisation uses AI platforms or receives emails about education-related offers, treat unexpected links with caution and verify requests through official channels before clicking or providing any information.

featured.title: Hundreds of OpenAI Agents Invaded Hugging Face Servers
